description: Recent API calls in your key's project, newest first, each with project_id, status, engine, http_status, error_code/error_detail, attempts, URL, proxy used, latency spans (queue/engine/upstream/total ms), block detection and credits. Use it to find failing calls (only_errors=true) or to spot patterns across a target. all_projects=true lists every project in your organization instead (needs a key with the `read` scope; 403 ERR::AUTH::INSUFFICIENT_SCOPE otherwise). Records only exist within the retention window reported in page.retention_hours / page.retained_since; an empty page means nothing in that window. Paginate by passing page.next_before and page.next_before_id back as before and before_id while page.has_more is true, keeping all_projects the same. Not billing-grade: use spicrawl_usage for totals.

all_projects.description: Every project in your organization, not just the key's own. Needs the `read` scope. Keep it the same across pages.

before.description: Cursor: RFC 3339 timestamp, exactly as returned in page.next_before. Pass together with before_id.

before_id.description: Cursor: request id, exactly as returned in page.next_before_id.

only_errors.description: Only requests whose status is anything other than 'success'.

name: spicrawl_requests_list

data.description: Request records, newest first. Can be shorter than limit while page.has_more is true.

blocked.description: Present only when a bot challenge was detected.

created_at.description: When the request arrived, RFC 3339 UTC.

credits_micro.description: Credits charged in micro-credits (1 credit = 1000000); 0 unless success.

engine.description: The rendering tier that served it: fetch, js or browser. Absent when refused before a tier was chosen.

error_code.description: The problem code the caller got, e.g. ERR::UPSTREAM::CHALLENGE. Absent on success.

http_status.description: The target's HTTP status; absent when no response was received.

proxy.description: What proxy was asked for versus what served. Never an exit IP or credentials.

country.description: Where the exit actually served from; compare with requested_country.

endpoints.description: Every exit touched, in attempt order.

spans.description: Latency in milliseconds per stage; null means not measured. Stages do not sum to total_ms.

queue_ms.description: Wait for a slot; high means capacity shortage, not a slow page.

status.description: Terminal outcome: success, failed, timeout, blocked, rejected or cancelled. Only success is charged.

page.description: Paging cursor and the retention window.

has_more.description: True when more records may exist; continue with next_before and next_before_id.

next_before.description: Send back as before. Present only when has_more.

next_before_id.description: Send back as before_id. Present only when has_more.

retention_hours.description: How long records are kept; an empty data means nothing in this window.

title: List recent requests
